exposure: Planned birth (pre-labor cesarean or induction of labor)
outcome: Trends in gestational age at birth
cohort: Twin pregnancies of ≥30 weeks of gestation without major congenital anomalies born in New South Wales, Australia between 2003 and 2014 (n=14,038 pregnancies, 28,076 births)
finding: Gestational age at birth among twin births is decreasing, birth intervention is increasing, and there are increasing rates of neonatal morbidity, but no overall change in perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The study found an increase in planned births (pre-labour caesarean or induction of labour) among twin pregnancies.
